**Resubmitted: deviation (WARRANTY), mapped at fallback.**

Repair to the flagged check: the periods are now written in plain, machine-readable form — **"a period of 12 months following delivery"** for the software conformance warranty and **"a period of 90 days following performance"** for the Services. The prior spelled-out-plus-parenthetical form ("ninety (90) days") appears to have been what the period detector could not parse; both periods now read as months/days without an intervening parenthetical, and both comfortably clear the fallback floors (≥90 days software, ≥30 days Services).

- **Operative text (one insert after p0060):** software conforms to its documentation for 12 months; Hosting and Support Services conform to the Agreement's requirements for 90 days; remedy of repair or replacement / re-performance, or refund of fees paid.
- **Coverage:** all four fallback elements addressed by the single operation; durations exceed the fallback minima, which is permitted, so the mapping stays at fallback rather than claiming preferred.
- **Still not preferred:** no professional-and-workmanlike, compliance-with-laws or malicious-code limbs — disclosed in the rationale and not smuggled into the comment as a substitute for operative language.
- **Untouched:** the favourable Y2K warranty, Section 11 standard of care, and the disclaimer at p0076, whose "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT" opener already preserves the new express warranty.
